scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Just a second! You're
carrying too many items
right now. You'd better
put your stuff in Kafra
Storage or you won't be
able to pick up anything new...
scripts.translation:
[范特]
请稍等！你现在携带的物品太多了。请先把物品存入卡普拉仓库，否则无法拾取新物品...

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Hi there, welcome
to my pub. So what
would you like to have?
scripts.translation:
[范特]
你好，欢迎光临我的酒馆。
那么，你想喝点什么？

scripts.text: Beer, please.
scripts.translation: 来杯啤酒

scripts.text: A cocktail, please.
scripts.translation: 来杯鸡尾酒

scripts.text: Soju, please.
scripts.translation: 来杯烧酒

scripts.text: Maybe later.
scripts.translation: 稍后再说

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Alright, let me get
you a glass of beer on
tap. There you are, this
is out special Schwaltz Beer.
scripts.translation:
[范特]
好，我给你接一杯生啤。给你，这是我们特制的施瓦茨啤酒。

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Gulp gulp gulp*^000000

[{0}]
Ahhh, it's really
good! That really
hits the spot!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
Ahhh，真好喝！正合我意！

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
I'm sorry, but I have to
deliver all of our cocktail
ingredients to other customers.
Maybe I'll have enough to make
you something next time, okay?
scripts.translation:
[范特]
抱歉，我必须把所有鸡尾酒原料都提供给其他顾客。
也许下次我会有足够的材料为你调制一杯，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
S-soju? I'm sorry,
but we don't serve that
here. It's too much of
a tough guy drink for me...
scripts.translation:
[范特]
烧...烧酒？抱歉，我们这里不卖那种酒。对我来说，那可是硬汉才喝的酒...

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Sure, just take
your time, relax,
and order something
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:

当然，请慢慢来，放松一下，想好了再点单。

scripts.text: A cocktail, please
scripts.translation: 来杯鸡尾酒

scripts.text: Soju, please.

scripts.text: You look worried, what's up?
scripts.translation: 你看起来很担心，怎么了？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

Alright, let me get
you a glass of beer on

I'm sorry, but I have to

Maybe I'll have enough to make
you something next time, okay?
scripts.translation:
[范特]
抱歉，我必须把所有鸡尾酒原料都提供给其他顾客。
也许下次我会有足够的材料为你调制一杯，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
S-soju? I'm sorry,
but we don't serve that
here. It's too much of
a tough guy drink for me...
scripts.translation:
[范特]
烧...烧酒？
抱歉，我们这里不供应那种酒。
对我来说，那太像硬汉喝的酒了...

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Oh, did you overhear?
I'm sorry, it's just that one
of my employees had an
accident and was pretty hurt,
so I have nodoby that can
deliver this merchandise.
scripts.translation:
[范特]
哦，你听到了？抱歉，我有个员工出了事故，伤得很重，所以现在没人能送这批货。

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
I have an urgent order
that I need to send to
the Kiel Hyre Academy,
but I can't find anyone
that's available for this
kind of temporary job.
scripts.translation:
[范特]
我有一批急货要送到基尔·海尔学院，但找不到合适的人来做这份临时工作。

scripts.text: I'm sorry to hear that
scripts.translation: 听到这个我很遗憾

scripts.text: Do you want me to help you?
scripts.translation: 需要我帮你吗？

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Well, I'm sure that I'll
figure something out.
Do you know anyone
that'd be interested in
some part time work?
scripts.translation:
[范特]
嗯，我相信我会想出办法的。
你认识对兼职工作感兴趣的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Really? That's great!
But first, I think it's fair to
tell you that this job may not
be as simple as you'd think.
I expect you to complete the
delivery, no matter what.
scripts.translation:
[范特]
真的吗？那太好了！不过我得先说明，这份工作可能不像你想的那么简单。无论如何，你都得把货送到。

scripts.text: Sure I'll do it
scripts.translation: 当然，我会做的

scripts.text: Wait, let me think about it...
scripts.translation: 等等，让我想想

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
I'm glad to hear that.
Well then, please take this
bottle of Culinary Wine to
Mrs. ^ff0000Lecollane^000000 in the Kiel
Hyre Academy. I'll pay you
once you finish the job, okay?
scripts.translation:
[范特]
太好了。那么，请把这瓶烹饪用葡萄酒送给基尔·海尔学院里的^ff0000勒科兰夫人^000000。送到后我会付你报酬，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Sure thing. I really need
to get this done, so if you
can't do it, but know any
capable, responsible
people that can, then please
tell them about my situation.
scripts.translation:
[范特]
没问题。
我真的很需要尽快完成这件事，如果你做不了，但认识任何有能力、负责任的人，请把我的情况告诉他们。

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Sure, just take
your time, relax,
and order something
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[范特]
当然，请慢慢来，放松一下，想好了再点单。

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Please deliver that bottle
of Wine I gave you to Mrs.
Mrs. ^ff0000Lecollane^000000, who should be
inside the Kiel Hyre Academy.
Hurry and get it to her before she
can complain about the delivery.
scripts.translation:
[范特]
请把我给你的那瓶葡萄酒送给基尔·海尔学院里的^ff0000勒科兰夫人^000000。快送过去，免得她抱怨送货太慢。

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Oh, you're back.
Thanks for making that
delivery. Just give me
a moment, and then I can
pay you in zeny, okay?
scripts.translation:
[范特]
哦，你回来了。谢谢你帮忙送货。稍等一下，我就用Zeny付你报酬，好吗？

scripts.text: I need more wine...
scripts.translation: 我需要更多的酒

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Oh, you need to deliver
another bottle? Alright,
let me look around, and
I'll give you the wine
and your payment.
scripts.translation:
[范特]
哦，你还要再送一瓶？好，让我找找。我会把酒和报酬都给你。

scripts.text:
^3355FFRummage Rummage^000000
^3355FFRummage Rummage^000000

[Vandt]
There you go!
Thank you so much
for helping me out~
scripts.translation:
[范特]
给你！
非常感谢你帮忙~

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Hey, thanks a lot
for helping me out that
last time. I knew I asked
you out of the blue, but
you ended up being a life
saver! I really appreciate it!
scripts.translation:
[范特]
嘿，非常感谢你上次的帮助。
我知道我是突然找你帮忙，但你真是救了我一命！
我真的很感激！

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
You're a really good
worker, you know that?
Dependable, responsible,
willing to help others, and
proactive too! I think you'll
go far in life, kid, I really do~
scripts.translation:
[范特]
你真是个好工人，你知道吗？
可靠、负责、乐于助人，而且很主动！
我觉得你以后会很有出息的，孩子，我真的这么认为~

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Arrrggghhh...
This can't be good...
This isn't good at all!
What am I suposed to do?
scripts.translation:
[范特]
啊啊啊...这下不妙...糟透了！
我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Fresh, crunchy toast!
If you want some, come
and get some tooooast~
Oh! Hi hi~ Did you want
to buy some yummy toast?
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
新鲜酥脆的吐司！
想吃的话，快来买吐司~
哦！你好呀~想买些好吃的吐司吗？

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Fresh, crunchy toast!
If you want some, come
and get some tooooast~
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
新鲜酥脆的吐司！
想吃的话，快来买吐司~

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Hot, fresh and
cruuuunchy toast!
Come and get some!
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
热乎乎、新鲜又酥脆的吐司！
快来买吧！

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Would you please go to
the Lighthalzen Windmill
and tell them that Cezu needs
lots of flour and lots of eggs!
Then, bring all the stuff over
to me as soon as you can~
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
请你去里希塔乐镇的风车磨坊，告诉他们塞祖需要很多面粉和很多鸡蛋！
然后，尽快把所有东西带给我~

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Hey, you're back with the
ingredients! Thank you so
much, I really needed these!
Now please give this flour
and these eggs to Elly, and
send her my regards. See you~
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
嘿，你带着食材回来了！
非常感谢，我真的很需要这些！
现在请把这些面粉和鸡蛋给艾莉，并代我向她问好。
再见~

scripts.text: I'm here for Elly
scripts.translation: 我是来找艾莉的

scripts.text: No, thanks
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Oh, I see. Elly must have
wasted another batch of
ingredients again. Well,
she's a regular customer,
so I really want to help, but
I can't really do anything.
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
哦，我明白了。艾莉肯定又浪费了一批食材。她是我的老顾客，我很想帮她，可我也无能为力。

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
You see, I just ran
out of ingredients too!
But I can't really leave
to get some more. What if
people need to buy toast?
Listen, can you help me out?
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
你看，我的食材也刚好用完了！
但我实在走不开去买新的。
万一有人来买吐司怎么办？
听着，能帮帮我吗？

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Would you please go get
some flour and eggs for me
from the ^3355FFLighthalzen Windmill^000000
Then, when you come back, I can
divide the ingredients, and you
can deliver some to Elly.
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
请去^3355FF里希塔乐镇风车磨坊^000000帮我买些面粉和鸡蛋。
你回来后，我会把食材分好，你再送一份给艾莉。

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
I know that I'm basically
making you do everything
on your own, but please try
to understand that my hands
are tied. D-don't ask me
why, they just are!
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
我知道这基本上是在让你一个人忙前忙后，但请体谅一下，我确实身不由己。
别...别问我为什么，反正就是这样！

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Okay okay~
Please come again!
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
好的好的~欢迎下次再来！

scripts.text:
[Mills]
Hey, you've got too much
stuff on you right now. 
Put your junk in Kafra Storage
if you expect me to give you
anything. That's why you came
here to the miss, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[米尔斯]
嘿，你身上带的东西太多了。想让我给你东西，就先把杂物存进卡普拉仓库。你大老远跑来找我，不就是为这个吗？

scripts.text:
[Mills]
Hey, whaddya want?
I'm pretty busy right
now, so you mind coming
back later? Then we'll talk.
scripts.translation:
[米尔斯]
嘿，你要什么？我现在挺忙的，能不能晚点再来？到时候我们再谈。

scripts.text:
[Mills]
Hey, whaddya want?
You just happened to
catch me at a good time,
but if you need anything,
you'd better spit it out quick
before things get hectic again.
scripts.translation:
[米尔斯]
嘿，你要什么？
你来得正好，我刚好有空，但如果你有什么事，最好趁现在赶紧说，不然一会儿又要忙起来了。

scripts.text: I'm here for Cezu
scripts.translation: 我是来找塞祖的

scripts.text:
[Mills]
Oh, Cezu from the
toast stand? Okay,
I've got everything
that kid needs right
here. There's eggs inside,
so be really careful with it.
It's ready for you...
scripts.translation:
[米尔斯]
哦，是卖吐司的塞祖啊。好的，那孩子要的东西我都备好了。里面有鸡蛋，拿的时候小心点。给你...

scripts.text:
[Mills]
Kid's one of my regular
customers, so you don't
have to pay me, or run any
extra errands on my end. Yeah,
I know how other people treat
you adventurers. Well, see ya.
scripts.translation:
[米尔斯]
那小孩是我的常客，所以不用付钱，也不用在我这儿跑腿。
嗯，我知道其他人是怎么对待你们这些冒险者的。
好了，再见。

scripts.text:
[Mills]
......
Um, okay, well, if
you need something,
just hollar, I guess.
Cuts, Cutz where are you?
You'd better not be goofing off!
scripts.translation:
[米尔斯]
...
嗯，好吧。要是需要什么就喊我吧。
库茨，库茨，你在哪？你最好别在偷懒！

scripts.text:
[Mills]
That Cutz is such
a lazy rascal. The guy
thinks he can fool around
when he's on the clock...!
Ah well, he knows I can't find
a better assistant. He'll learn...
scripts.translation:
[米尔斯]
库茨真是个懒鬼。他以为上班时间还能混日子...！
唉，谁叫我找不到更好的助手呢。他迟早会学乖的...

scripts.text:
[Cutz]
Man, why are we
always so busy?
Why does Mills have
to work me to the bone?
Eh, it's a living, I suppose...
scripts.translation:
[库茨]
天哪，我们为什么总是这么忙？
米尔斯为什么总让我累死累活？
唉，也是为了混口饭吃...

scripts.text:
[Cutz]
Wh-what makes you
think I'm goofing off,
Mills? L-look, look,
my hands are moving,
I'm busy, I'm working!
scripts.translation:
[库茨]
你...你凭什么说我在偷懒，米尔斯？
看...看，我手一直在动呢！我很忙，我在干活！

scripts.text:
[Cutz]
Hey, you're from
Cezu's toast stand,
right? How is cute
little Cezu doing?
scripts.translation:
[库茨]
嘿，你是从塞祖的吐司摊来的吧？
那个可爱的塞祖最近怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Hanie]
Oh, I wish I could study
at the Kiel Hyre Academy...
All of the graduates get
really nice jobs! I'm almost
jealous of the students!
scripts.translation:
[哈妮]
哦，我真希望能在基尔·海尔学院读书...那里的毕业生都能找到很好的工作！我都快羡慕那些学生了！

scripts.text: Kiel Hyre Academy?
scripts.translation: 基尔·海尔学院？

scripts.text:
[Hanie]
Oh, the Kiel Hyre Academy
is a school founded by Kiel
Hyre, an inventor that became
rich from his strange machines.
He decided to give back to society
by building this private academy.
scripts.translation:
[哈妮]
哦，基尔·海尔学院是由基尔·海尔创立的。
他是一位发明家，靠那些奇怪的机器发了财。
他决定回馈社会，于是建立了这所私立学院。

scripts.text:
[Hanie]
However, the school will
only accept orphans that are
too poor to enroll in any other
schools. Sometimes, it makes
me wish that I was an orphan too!
Well, not really, but you know...
scripts.translation:
[哈妮]
不过，学校只收穷得上不起其他学校的孤儿。有时候，我真希望自己也是孤儿！
嗯，其实也不是啦，你懂的...

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
I'm sorry, but if you aren't
associated with this institution,
then you're not authorized to
enter the ^FF0000Kiel Hyre Academy^000000.
Please leave if you don't have
an appointment with the staff.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
很抱歉，如果您与本院无关，则无权进入^FF0000基尔·海尔学院^000000。
如果没有预约，请离开。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
I'm sorry, but if you aren't
associated with this institution,
then you're not authorized to
enter the ^FF0000Kiel Hyre Academy^000000.
Please leave if you don't have
an appointment with the staff.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
很抱歉，如果您与本院无关，则无权进入^FF0000基尔·海尔学院^000000。
如果没有预约，请离开。

scripts.text: I'm here for a delivery.
scripts.translation: 我是来送货的

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
You're here to deliver
something? Okay, just give
me the recipient's ^FF0000name^000000,
followed by the ^FF0000item^000000 being
delivered, and I'll verify it
before letting you inside.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
你是来送货的？
好的，请告诉我收件人的^FF0000姓名^000000，以及所送^FF0000物品^000000的名称，我会核实后再让你进去。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
You're here to deliver some
Wine to...to who? What was
the name? I...I don't think
we have anybody in the
academy named {0}
scripts.translation:
[保安]
你是来送...送酒给谁？
收件人叫什么名字？我...我想学院里没有叫{0}的人。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
So you're here to make
a delivery to Mrs. Lecollane?
What is it you've brought for
her? Some ^3355FF{0}^000000?
scripts.translation:
[保安]
所以你是来给勒科兰夫人送货的？
你给她带了什么？
是^3355FF{0}^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Let me buzz her first,
and check to make sure
that she's been expecting
you. Let's see now...
scripts.translation:
[保安]
让我先通知她一下，确认她是否在等你。
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Huh. Mrs Lecollane
is expecting a delivery,
but not the item that you
say that you've brought for
her. You might want to check
to see if there's been a mixup...
scripts.translation:
[英格丽德]
它威力惊人、射程极远，人体工学设计让它握持舒适，还能大幅减轻开火时的后坐力。
这绝对配得上神枪手终极武器的称号。
呼哧 呼哧...

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Alright....
So you're here to
deliver a bottle of
Wine to Mrs. Lecollane?
Let me buzz her, and get
this confirmed real quickly.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
好的...所以你是来给勒科兰夫人送一瓶酒的？
让我通知她，马上确认一下。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Okay, everything looks
good. Mrs. Lecollane
has been expecting you.
I guess you can enter.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
好的，一切正常。
勒科兰夫人一直在等你。
我想你可以进去了。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
If you don't have
an appoointment, then
don't loiter around in
front of the academy!
scripts.translation:
[保安]
如果没有预约，就不要在学院门口逗留！

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Oh, did you have
other business inside
the academy? I remember
you from before, so there
shouldn't be any problems
letting you back inside...
scripts.translation:
[保安]
哦，你还有其他事要进学院吗？
我记得你，之前来过，所以让你再进去应该没问题...

scripts.text:
[Laci]
Oh, wow! We usually
don't get visitors on
campus! Um, you're not
a new faculty member, are you?
scripts.translation:
[拉西]
哇！
我们很少见到校外的人呢！
嗯，你不是新来的老师吧？

scripts.text:
[Laci]
Hey, Nesha...!
have you heard why
Aaci hasn't been coming
to class for awhile?
scripts.translation:
[拉西]
嘿，内莎...！
你听说阿西为什么最近没来上课吗？

scripts.text:
[Gui Nesha]
That's right, I haven't
seen Aaci in awhile.
Did something happen?
scripts.translation:
[桂内莎]
是啊，我好久没见阿西了。
发生什么事了吗？

scripts.text:
[Laci]
It's because....
Aaci saw a freakin' ghost!
It's one hundred percent
true! I heard about it from,
well, you know, my sources.
scripts.translation:
[英格丽德]
哈哈~ 看我自顾自地说了这么多，你明明什么都没问。
抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Gui Nesha]
...Wha...?
Oh, come on,
get outta town.
scripts.translation:
[桂内莎]
...什...？
拜托，别胡说了。

scripts.text:
[Gui Nesha]
Aren't we a little
old to be talking about
this kind of stuff? You
know, rumors and ghost
stories that make no sense?
C'mon, Laci, knock it off!
scripts.translation:
[桂内莎]
我们是不是有点大了，还聊这种话题？
你知道的，那些毫无根据的谣言和鬼故事？
拜托，拉西，别闹了！

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Lecollane]
Is there a problem?
Outsiders are not allowed to come
in here, please leave.
scripts.translation:
[勒科兰夫人]
出什么事了吗？
外人不得入内，请离开。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Lecollane]
Oh, hello. Ah!
have you come to
deliver my wine? The
security guard called and
mentioned you were coming.
scripts.translation:
[勒科兰夫人]
哦，你好。
啊！
你是来送我的酒的吧？
保安刚才打电话说你要来。

scripts.text: Yes, that's right!
scripts.translation: 是的，没错！

scripts.text: Er, s-sorry!
scripts.translation: 啊，对...对不起！

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Lecollane]
Well, you've come a little
later than I thought, but
I suppose it can't be helped.
I guess the waiting has just
heightened my anticipation
for this bottle of wi--
scripts.translation:
[勒科兰夫人]
嗯，你来得比我预想的晚了一点，不过也没办法。等待只让我更加期待这瓶葡萄酒——

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Cling! Crrrack!*^000000

[Mrs. Lecollane]
Elly? Elly did you
break something again?!
You've got to be more careful!
If you don't finish baking those
cookies by the end of today, your
semester grades will suffer!
scripts.translation:
[勒科兰夫人]
艾莉？
艾莉，你又把什么东西弄坏了？！
你得小心一点！
如果你今天结束前不烤完那些饼干，你的学期成绩就要受影响啦！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
B-but I just...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
但...但是我只是...

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Lecollane]
^FF0000Elly^000000!!

[Elly]
......
Yes, Mrs. Lecollane.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
...
是的，勒科兰夫人。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Lecollane]
*Ahem* Excuse me.
Would you please leave
the wine over there? You
may go now, and please
don't wander needlessly
around the academy.
scripts.translation:
[勒科兰夫人]
*咳咳* 抱歉。
请把酒放在那里。你可以走了，请不要在学院里随意闲逛。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Lecollane]
Hm...?
I guess I must
be mistaken. I'm
sorry, I thought you
were somebody else.
scripts.translation:
[勒科兰夫人]
嗯...？
我想我认错人了。抱歉，我刚才把你当成别人了。

scripts.text:
[Mrs Lecollane]
Well, our business is
completed, so would you
please leave the campus
as soon as you can? *Sigh*
I can't believe our future
is in these girls' hands...
scripts.translation:
[勒科兰夫人]
既然事情办完了，请尽快离开校园。*叹气* 真不敢相信，我们的未来竟掌握在这些女孩手里...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I'm sorry, but would you
put some of your things in
your Kafra Storage first or
something? I can't really
help you when you're 
carrying so much stuff.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
抱歉，你能不能先把一些东西存到卡普拉仓库里？
你拿着这么多东西，我实在帮不了你。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
W-wah! Oh...!
^333333*Phew*^000000 That was close,
I almost dropped them 
again! Why do I have so much
trouble handling ingredients?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
哇！啊...！^333333*呼*^000000好险，差点又把东西打翻！我怎么总是处理不好食材？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh no, what should
I do? ^333333*Sob*^000000 Wh-what
am I going to do? ^333333*Sniff*^000000
What happened?
scripts.translation: 发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I... I have to finish baking
this batch of cookies by the
end of today, but then I spilled
all of the ingredients on the
floor. I don't know how I can
bake those cookies now...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我...我必须在今天结束前烤完这批饼干，可我把所有材料都洒在地上了。现在不知道该怎么烤...

scripts.text: What can I do to help you?
scripts.translation: 我能帮你做什么？

scripts.text: Oh, I'm so sorry.
scripts.translation: 哦，真对不起

scripts.text:
[Elly]
What was that...?
You'll really help
me? That's wonderful!
Thank you! Thanks so much!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
刚才...？你真的愿意帮我？太好了！谢谢你！真的太感谢了！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Wait, you don't go
to this school, don't
you? Y-you're one of
those adventurers, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
等等，你不是这所学校的学生，对吧？
你...你是那些冒险者之一，对吗？

scripts.text: Yeah, that's right.
scripts.translation: 是啊，没错。

scripts.text:
Listen, I know you
probably have your own
plans, but do  you think
you can help me with this
huge problem that I have?
scripts.translation: 听着，我知道你可能也有自己的安排，但你能不能帮我解决这个大麻烦？

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Decline
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
How Wonderful!
Thank you! Thank you
so much! I'm supposed to
finish baking this batch of
cookies soon, but I spilled
all of the ingredients...
scripts.translation: 太好了！谢谢你！真的非常感谢！我本来很快就能烤完这批饼干了，可我把所有材料都洒了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm outta here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我先走了。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
W-wait...!
Come back, you
d-don't...! I really
need some help!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
等...等一下！
回来，你...你不能...！我真的需要帮忙！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Well, I guess the only way
I can bake these cookies is
to get some new ingredients.
I'm sorry to be such a burden,
but if you didn't offer to help
me, then I'd have no one to ask!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
看来我只能再找些新材料来烤饼干了。真抱歉给你添麻烦，不过要不是你主动帮忙，我都不知道该找谁！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
You don't understand how
important it is that I bake
these cookies... If I don't
finish this assignment, then
Mrs. Crank will fail me for
the entire semester!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
你不知道烤好这些饼干对我有多重要...如果我完不成作业，克兰克夫人就会让我整学期都不及格！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Okay, I need to calm
down. I think I can do
this with your help.
Would you please do me
this huge favor and bring
all of these ingredients?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
好了，我得冷静一下。
我觉得有你的帮忙应该没问题。
能请你帮个大忙，把这些材料都带给我吗？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Let's see... You can
get Wine from a pub in
Juno, Cacaos from hunting
Yoyos, and you can get flour
and Eggs from the girl that
runs the Toast Stand in Juno.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我想想...朱诺的酒吧有葡萄酒，打溜溜猴能得到可可，面粉和鸡蛋则可以找朱诺吐司摊的老板娘买。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Good luck, getting
everything, and I hope
you hurry back here with
those cookie ingredients
as quickly as you can, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
祝你好运，希望你能尽快把这些饼干材料带回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
*Sob*...

[Elly]
Let's see, would you
like me to remind you
which ingredients I need?
Please bring these things as
soon as you can so that I can
quickly bake some cookies~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
让我想想...要我再提醒你需要哪些材料吗？请尽快把它们带来，这样我就能马上烤饼干了~

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Let's see... You can
get Wine from a pub in
Juno, Cacaos from hunting
Yoyos, and you can get flour
and Eggs from the girl that
runs the Toast Stand in Juno.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
让我想想...你可以在朱诺的酒馆买到葡萄酒，打溜溜猴能获得可可豆，面粉和鸡蛋则可以向朱诺吐司摊的女孩购买。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Hooray! Finally, I have
everything I need! This is
great! Oh, would you please
give me a moment while I bake
these cookies?  It shouldn't take
long, so hold on just a bit.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
万岁！终于集齐所有材料了！太好了！
哦，请给我一点时间烤这些饼干，好吗？应该很快就好，请稍等。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Tadah! I did it!
They're finally done!
Elly's special cookies.
I'd like you to have some
as thanks for helping me out.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
当当！
成功了！
终于烤好了！
艾莉特制饼干。
为了感谢你的帮忙，我想请你尝尝。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I'm sorry, but I was so
preoccupied with baking
these cookies that I didn't
even ask for your name. I'm
^FF0000Ellyja^000000, but everybody calls me,
''Elly.'' What's your name?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
真抱歉，我刚才太专注于烤饼干了，竟然忘了问你的名字。
我是^FF0000艾莉嘉^000000，但大家都叫我“艾莉”。
你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
{0}?
...that name! It's wonderful!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
{0}？
...这个名字真好听！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I'm sorry, but I have
another favor to ask you
if you don't mind helping
me out again. Don't worry,
you won't have to hurry as
quickly as you did last time.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
真抱歉，如果你不介意再帮我的话，我还有另一个请求。
别担心，这次你不用像上次那样那么着急。

scripts.text: What do you need?
scripts.translation: 你需要什么？

scripts.text: Sorry, but I'm pretty busy...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我有点忙

scripts.text:
[Elly]
You know how you helped
me bake those cookies?
It's the first time I was able
to do it without burning them!
I just know Grandfather'd
be so proud of me!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
你还记得你帮我烤饼干的事吗？那是我第一次没把饼干烤焦！我知道祖父一定会为我骄傲的！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I really want Grandfather
to taste the cookies I baked,
but the cookies will be stale
by the time I'm able to leave
campus. Would you deliver these
cookies to my grandfather for me?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我真的很想让祖父尝尝我烤的饼干，但等我离开校园时，饼干可能就不新鲜了。
你能帮我把这些饼干送给我的祖父吗？

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 我很忙

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh, {0}!
Thank you so much, I knew
you'd understand! Would you
please bring the cookies to
him at ^FF0000Kiel Hyre's cottage^000000?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
啊，{0}！
太感谢你了，我就知道你会理解的！
请帮我把饼干送到^FF0000基尔·海尔的别墅^000000好吗？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh, right! They're really
careful about visitors and
keeping strangers off the
property, but if you mention
my name, they'll let you in.
Alright then, see you~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
哦，对了！
他们对访客和陌生人进入领地非常严格，但如果你提到我的名字，他们就会让你进去。
那么，再见啦~

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh, um...
Okay, I'm sorry to
have bothered you...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
啊，那个...
好吧，抱歉打扰你了...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh, um...
Okay, I'm sorry to
have bothered you...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
啊，那个...
好吧，抱歉打扰你了...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh, you don't know where
to find Kiel Hyre's cottage?
It's just north from this
academy. Please deliver my
cookies to Grandfather, and
let him know I really miss him.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
哦，你不知道基尔·海尔的别墅在哪里吗？
它就在这所学院的北边。
请把我的饼干送给祖父，并告诉他我很想念他。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Hm? Grandfather's not
home? That's strange, he
didn't mention anything about
any business trips. I thought
he'd be at home all day...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
嗯？
祖父不在家？
这很奇怪，他并没有提到要去出差。
我以为他今天会一直在家...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Would you go back to his
cottage one more time? Here,
you can use this Cottage Key.
That way, you can just go
inside and talk to him~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
你能再去一趟他的别墅吗？给你这把别墅钥匙。这样你就能直接进去和他谈谈了~

scripts.text:
[Elly]
That's so weird...
I thought Grandfather
said that he'd be at
home all day today...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
真奇怪...
我以为爷爷说过今天会一直在家...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Hmm...?
What's this,
a letter for me?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
嗯...？
这是什么？一封写给我的信？

scripts.text:
^3355FFElly opened the envelope
and started reading the letter.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF艾莉拆开信封，开始读信。^000000

scripts.text:
^333333Dearest Elly,
 
I have something to discuss
with my son Kiehl, so I am
leaving to meet with him.
If you don't hear from me
after 7 days after I've written
this letter, then you must
escape the academy as soon
as possible, and retrieve
something inside our 
cottage's study.
 
If you have a friend you
can trust, please ask him
to follow my traces in the
cottage. I might be in danger,
and in dire need of rescue.
 
Elly, don't trust anyone
in the academy, even your
classmates, since they may
be influenced by Kiehl.
 
Be careful, and I love you.
 
--Grandpa^000000
scripts.translation:
^333333亲爱的艾莉：

我有些事要和儿子基尔商量，所以要去见他。如果你在我写下这封信后的七天内仍未收到我的消息，就尽快逃离学院，并取回我们别墅书房里的某样东西。

如果你有信得过的朋友，请让他循着我在别墅留下的痕迹找来。我可能身处险境，急需救援。

艾莉，不要相信学院里的任何人，即使是你的同学，他们也可能受到基尔的影响。

小心，我爱你。

——爷爷^000000

scripts.text:
[Elly]
What? Oh no, it's been
ten days since he wrote
this letter! Ah, does this
mean that he's in danger?!
Oh no, what should I do?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
什么？天哪，他写这封信已经是十天前了！这是不是意味着他有危险？！
天哪，我该怎么办？

scripts.text: About your grandpa
scripts.translation: 关于你爷爷的事

scripts.text: Tell me about Kiehl
scripts.translation: 告诉我关于基尔的事

scripts.text: What's with this academy?
scripts.translation: 这所学院是怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh! My grandfather is
Kiel Hyre, founder and
CEO of the Kiel Hyre
foundation. He looks
strict and cold hearted,
but he's actually very nice!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
哦！我的祖父是基尔·海尔，基尔·海尔基金会的创始人兼首席执行官。他看起来严厉又冷漠，但其实人很好！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
We're not related by
blood, but he's taken
care of me ever since
I lost my parents. Oh,
Grandapa, where are you?
I'm getting so worried!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我们没有血缘关系，但自从我失去父母后，他就一直照顾我。
爷爷，你在哪里？我好担心！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Kiehl? That's my
grandfather's son...
I don't know him that
well, and only saw him
once at an academy event.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
基尔？那是我爷爷的儿子...我不太了解他，只在学院的一次活动上见过他。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Mmm, he's a good looking
guy with pale skin, silver
hair, and this cold, fierce
stare. A lot of my classmates
worship Kiehl because he's
also a business genius~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
嗯，他长得很英俊，皮肤白皙，留着银发，目光冰冷而锐利。很多同学都崇拜基尔，因为他也是商业奇才~

scripts.text:
[Elly]
It's weird though...
I have no idea why my
grandpa and Kiehl don't
get along. They're both
really good at what they do...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
不过真奇怪...我不知道爷爷和基尔为什么合不来。他们各自都很有本事...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Well, I know the security
here is really tight, but
that's because everything
here is so luxurious and
expensive, you know~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
嗯，我知道这里的安保非常严密，但那是因为这里的一切都极其奢华昂贵，你知道的~

scripts.text:
[Elly]
We also have a very
special curriculum where
you learn more of what you
want. Personally, I want to
become a great career woman
like ^0000FFMs. Allysia^000000. Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
这里的课程安排也很特别，你可以多学自己感兴趣的内容。
我想成为像^0000FF艾莉西亚女士^000000那样出色的职业女性。嘿嘿~~

scripts.text:
[Elly]
This place certainly
isn't like other schools.
Yeah, everything is made to
fit each of the student's needs.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
这里确实不像其他学校。
是的，这里的一切都是为了满足每位学生的需求而设立的。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Recently, though?
Some really weird stuff
has been happening. All of
my classmates are afraid of
going out alone by themselves.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
不过最近？
发生了一些非常奇怪的事情。
我的同学们都害怕独自外出。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
But I'll be okay!
You'll be there to
rescue me from danger,
right, {0}?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
但我没问题的！
你会在那里把我从危险中救出来，对吧，{0}？

scripts.text: Who is Ms. Allysia?
scripts.translation: 艾莉西亚女士是谁？

scripts.text: Strange incidents?
scripts.translation: 奇怪的事件？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh, Ms. Allysia is
Grandfather's secretary~
She's so beautiful, and
my grandfather really
trusts her with everything!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
哦，艾莉西亚女士是爷爷的秘书~她非常美丽，而且爷爷非常信任她，把一切都交给她！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Well, {0}...
I'm not supposed to tell
anyone outside of the school,
but I can trust you! You see...
We're haunted by a ghost!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
嗯，{0}...
我不该把这件事告诉校外的人，不过我信得过你！你看...我们被幽灵缠上了！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I know it sounds crazy,
but this ghost wanders the
campus, and curses its victims,
making them so cold and lifeless.
It happened to my roommate,
Mayo. It's like she's a statue...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我知道这听起来很荒唐，但有个幽灵在校园里游荡，会诅咒受害者，让他们变得冰冷、毫无生气。我的室友梅奥就中了诅咒，现在像尊雕像...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I snuck into the medical
office to see her, and she...
She couldn't do anything!
What would happen if the
ghost decided to curse me?!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我偷偷溜进医务室去看她，可她...她完全动不了！要是幽灵也来诅咒我，该怎么办？！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
You know what...?
If I ever got cursed
by that ghost, just yell
''^FF0000Wake up, Elly!^000000''
That'll wake me up for sure!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
你知道吗...？
如果我被那个幽灵诅咒了，只要大喊“^FF0000醒醒，艾莉！^000000”，肯定就能把我叫醒！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Argh, I'm in a fix!
I have to finish my
homework before it's due!
Yeah, I've got to go see
Mrs. Lecollane now.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
啊，我遇到麻烦了！
我必须在截止前完成作业！
是的，我现在得去见勒科兰夫人了。

[Elly]
Say, {0},
if it's okay, would you
please go find what my
grandpa left for me in
the ^FF0000cottage study^000000? You're
the only one I can trust!

[艾莉]
对了，{0}，如果方便的话，请去^FF0000小屋的书房^000000找找爷爷留给我的东西，好吗？你是我唯一信得过的人！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Anyway, I'll see you later
in the evening! Please come
by my ^FF0000dorm room^000000. Um, the
dorms are in the church just
behind the academy, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
总之，晚上见！请到我的^FF0000宿舍^000000来。宿舍就在学院后面的教堂里，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
My room is in the back,
and it's on the ^FF0000second floor^000000
^FF0000on the left side^000000. Please use
a ladder to come up, okay?
I'll leave my window open
for you, so just come, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我的房间在后面，位于^FF0000二楼^000000的^FF0000左侧^000000。请爬梯子上来，好吗？
我会把窗户打开，你直接进来就行。

scripts.text:
[Elly]

teacher's coming!

快一点，快一点，老师要来了！

^3355FFYou can see a curtain
decorated with a cute

window of this room,

^3355FFThis must be Elly's room.
It doesn't sound like anyone
is inside, so she probably
isn't back yet. For now, you
should try to find what her
grandfather left for her

find a ladder to enter her
window, you probably won't

to climb up that water pipe...^000000

Inventory space first...^000000

scripts.text:
Dearest Elly,
Kiehl finally broke the taboo,
and tried to transform you guys
into something horrible.
^FFFFFF_^000000

my life is probably in danger.
Whether I live depends on you.
^FFFFFF_^000000

meet Puppet, but I want to tell

you to find Allysia inside
the factory's secret room.

her security system, so don't
worry. Hopefully, Allysia will
then come to save me...
^FFFFFF_^000000
Sorry about that,
Grandpa

基尔终于打破禁忌，试图把你们变成可怕的东西。

我的生死取决于你。

{0}, help!

scripts.text:
^333333Dearest {0},
 
My teachers usually yell at me
since I make so many mistakes,
but today Mrs. Lecollane gave me
praise for my yummy cookies!
It's all thanks to you, my friend.
I'm very happy we've met:
you've taught me that there
are good people in the world.
And I know Grandpa will like
you, though, I don't know
where he could be...
 
Someday, I hope to become
as nice a person as you are.
Let's keep in touch and be
really good friends, okay?
 
Yours, Elly^000000
scripts.translation:
^333333亲爱的{0}：

老师通常会因为我犯很多错误而责骂我，但今天勒科兰夫人却夸我的饼干很好吃！
这都要感谢你，我的朋友。
我很高兴能遇见你：是你让我知道，世界上还是有好人的。
我知道爷爷也会喜欢你的，虽然我不知道他现在在哪里...

总有一天，我希望自己也能成为像你一样善良的人。
让我们保持联系，做好朋友，好吗？

你的，艾莉^000000

to reveal a secret path.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你下意识地从书架上抽出一本书。
当你把书拉向自己时，墙壁滑开了，露出一条秘密通道。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis bookshelf is
crammed with many
large, hardcover books.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这个书架上塞满了许多厚重的精装之书。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFJust a minute...!
There's something on
the floor here, but you
can't pick it up since
you're carrying too
many items now.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下...！
这里地上有东西，但你现在携带的物品太多了，无法捡起来。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a letter
on the floor. Naturally,
you pick it up, despite
the fact that it's not
addressed to you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在地上发现了一封信。
尽管信上并没有写你的名字，但你还是自然而然地把它捡了起来。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou entered the room.^000000

^FFFFFF##^000000*Tasty-Nutricious-Delicious*
*Cute Pet Doof Vending Machine*
The best food for your Cute Pets
that is superior to the Pet Food
you can buy in the market!
^FFFFFF_^000000
Price: 1,100 zeny (cheap!)
scripts.translation:
^FFFFFF##^000000*美味-营养-可口*
*可爱宠物食品自动售货机*
给你的可爱宠物最好的食物，比市场上买到的宠物饲料还要好！
^FFFFFF_^000000
价格：1,100 Zeny（很便宜！）

scripts.text: Buy!
scripts.translation: 购买！

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnfortunately, you
don't have enough
zeny to insert into
the vending machine.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF很遗憾，你的Zeny不足，无法投入自动售货机。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFOh no...!^000000
^3355FF1,100 zeny seems kind
of expensive for Pet Food,
but if it's better than the
normal stuff, it might
be worth a shot.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF糟糕...！^000000
^3355FF1,100 Zeny 对宠物饲料来说似乎有点贵，但如果它比普通饲料更好，也许值得一试。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFOh no...!
There's nothing
special about it
at all! It's just
normal Pet Food!
scripts.translation:
^3355FF糟糕...！
它根本没有什么特别之处！
这就是普通的宠物饲料！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis vending machine
seems really shady and
suspicious for some reason.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这台自动售货机不知为何看起来非常可疑。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a box filled with
ripe, delicious apples.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一个装满成熟美味苹果的箱子。^000000

scripts.text: Take the box
scripts.translation: 拿走箱子

scripts.text: Leave it
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text:
^3355FFNo...! Wait!
Something's wrong!
Whatever you do,
don't take this box!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF不...等等！
有些不对劲！
无论如何，都别拿这个箱子！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAnd so, your inner
voice, your Jungian
shadow if you will,
prevented you from
taking the box.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF于是，你内心的声音，或者说你的荣格阴影，阻止了你拿走箱子。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFSomething is wrong
with this box of apples.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这箱苹果有些不对劲。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFA magnificent world map,
detailing the Rune-Midgarts
Kingdom, Schwarzwald Republic,
as well as another country to the
west whose name is unfamiliar
to you, is pasted to this wall.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF墙上贴着一张精美的大陆地图，详细描绘了卢恩·米德加兹王国、修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国，以及西边一个你闻所未闻的国家。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you examine the
world map more closely,
you find that something has
been hidden underneath it.^000000
^3355FFWhatever might be
hidden beneath this
map probably isn't
important enough for
you to investigate.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你仔细端详世界地图时，发现下面似乎藏着什么东西。^000000
^3355FF藏在地图下面的东西大概不重要，不值得你去探究。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you examine the
world map more closely,
you find that something has
been hidden underneath it.^000000
^3355FFUnfortunately, you can't
see what's under the map
since it's pasted to the wall.
You'll need to find some
way to loosen the glue
without damaging the map...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你仔细端详世界地图时，发现下面似乎藏着什么东西。^000000
^3355FF可惜地图贴在墙上，你看不到下面是什么。你得想办法在不损坏地图的情况下把胶水弄松...^000000

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text: Examine
scripts.translation: 调查

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou bring the pot of
steaming hot liquid
close to the world map.
As the paste on the wall
moistens, the map slowly
begins to peel back.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你将那锅滚烫的液体靠近世界地图。随着墙上的胶水受潮，地图开始慢慢剥落。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe peeling map reveals
a folded piece of paper
hidden beneath it. You
take the paper, and smooth
the map out to adhere it to the
wall once again. A message is
written on the piece of paper.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF地图剥落后，露出藏在下面的一张折叠纸条。你取下纸条，再把地图抚平，重新贴回墙上。纸条上写着一段话。^000000

scripts.text:
^0000FFShe will be in a place
as cold as the poles.
When the well is dried
and the earth is cracked,
the path to her heart, a
heart as transparent as
crystal, will be open.^000000
scripts.translation:
^0000FF她将在如极地般寒冷的地方。
当井水干涸，大地龟裂，通往她内心的道路便会开启，那是一颗如水晶般透明的心。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFI'll have to fight four
snakes with four swords
to find her. The first sword
is love. The second sword
is despair. The third sword
is rage. The fourth sword is
hope. To find her, to rescue her.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF我必须挥舞四把剑，与四条蛇战斗才能找到她。
第一把剑是爱，第二把剑是绝望，第三把剑是愤怒，第四把剑是希望。
为了找到她，为了拯救她。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FF...............................
The deeper meaning
of this poem, if it even
exists, eludes you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF...
这首诗更深层的含义——如果它确实有含义的话——你怎么也参不透。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is were you found
the paper on which the
poem was written. Perhaps
it would be a good idea to
refresh your memory and
read that poem again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你就是在这里发现了写有那首诗的纸条。也许该回想一下，再读一遍那首诗。^000000

scripts.text: Read
scripts.translation: 阅读

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^0000FFShe will be in a place
as cold as the poles.
When the well is dried
and the earth is cracked,
the path to her heart, a
heart as transparent as
crystal, will be open.^000000
scripts.translation:
^0000FF她将在如极地般寒冷的地方。
当井水干涸，大地龟裂，通往她内心的道路便会开启，那是一颗如水晶般透明的心。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFI'll have to fight four
snakes with four swords
to find her. The first sword
is love. The second sword
is despair. The third sword
is rage. The fourth sword is
hope. To find her, to rescue her.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF我必须挥舞四把剑，与四条蛇战斗才能找到她。
第一把剑是爱，第二把剑是绝望，第三把剑是愤怒，第四把剑是希望。
为了找到她，为了拯救她。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FF...............................
The deeper meaning
of this poem, if it even
exists, eludes you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF...
这首诗更深层的含义——如果它确实有含义的话——你怎么也参不透。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's no need for
you to reread this poem.
You're a freakin' genius!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF没必要重读这首诗。
你简直是个天才！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a pot
filled with boiling,
steaming liquid.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一锅沸腾冒烟的液体。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a pot
filled with boiling,
steaming liquid.
Steam... That you could
use to loosen the glue on
the map... You're a genius!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现了一锅沸腾冒烟的液体。
蒸汽...可以用来软化地图上的胶水...你真是个天才！^000000

scripts.text: Try it.
scripts.translation: 试试看

scripts.text: That? That won't work!
scripts.translation: 那样？那行不通！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou picked up the
boiling pot, but
slightly burned your
hands by accident.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你拿起那锅沸腾的液体，却不小心烫伤了手。

scripts.text:
^3355FFNo, no...
We'd better try
something else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF不，不...
我们最好换个办法。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is where you
picked up the pot filled
with steaming hot liquid.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这里是你拿起那锅沸腾冒烟液体的地方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThat's a nice looking
calabash. You might even
get something from it...
But first you better get
rid of all your extra weight.
And by weight, I mean items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这葫芦看起来不错，说不定里面有东西...不过首先，你得清出一些负重空间。
这里说的负重，是指物品。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's an expensive
looking calabash--
or in less fancy
words, a ''gourd.''
Would do you do?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这是一个看起来很贵的葫芦——说白了，就是个葫芦。
你要怎么做？^000000

scripts.text: Break Open Calabash
scripts.translation: 砸开葫芦

scripts.text: Look Inside Calabash
scripts.translation: 查看葫芦内部

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou can't break
open that calabash...
You're a hero, not a vandal.
Now, if this act of vandalism
can be considered an act of
heroism, then it'd be okay.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你不能砸开那个葫芦...你是英雄，不是破坏者。
不过，如果这种破坏行为也能算作英雄之举，那就另当别论了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tenderly place
your hand into the
calabash, and gently
feel around with your
fingers until you retrieve
an Old Bronze Key.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你小心翼翼地把手伸进葫芦，轻轻摸索，终于取出一把旧青铜钥匙。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's probably
nothing inside anyway.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF里面大概什么都没有吧。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the expensive
looking calabash from
which you've obtained
the Old Bronze Key.
It's useless to you now.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这就是那个看起来很贵的葫芦，你曾从中取出旧青铜钥匙。
现在它对你来说已经没用了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a fancy pool
filled with fresh water.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一个精致的池子，里面装满了清水。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a fancy pool
filled with fresh water,
along with a conscpicuous
lion statue with two handles.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现一个精致的水池，里面盛满了清水，旁边还有一尊显眼的狮子雕像，带有两个把手。^000000

scripts.text: Pull Handles
scripts.translation: 拉动把手

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
Which handle would
you like to pull first?
scripts.translation: 你想先拉哪个把手？

scripts.text: Right Handle
scripts.translation: 右侧把手

scripts.text: Left Handle
scripts.translation: 左侧把手

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou pull the right
handle, causing water
to gush out of the lion's
mouth. It looks pretty cool~^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你拉动了右侧的把手，水从狮子口中喷涌而出。
看起来挺酷的~^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs soon as you pull the
left handle, the water in
the pool drains away. The
pool empties, and you can
see a layer of green moss
covering the pool's bottom.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF当你拉动左侧的把手时，池中的水迅速排空。
池子变空了，你可以看到池底覆盖着一层绿色的苔藓。^000000

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text: Investigate
scripts.translation: 调查

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide that
a pool is little more
than a hole without
any water to fill it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你觉得，没有水的池子不过就是个坑。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you look through
the wet moss at the
bottom of the pool,
you stumble upon a
small, peculiar button.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF当你透过潮湿的苔藓看向池底时，你发现了一个小巧而奇特的按钮。^000000

scripts.text: Press button
scripts.translation: 按下按钮

scripts.text: Don't Press Button
scripts.translation: 不按按钮

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou press the button,
which seems to trigger
a strange sound coming
from the stairs at the hallway.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你按下了按钮，似乎触发了某种机关，走廊尽头的楼梯处传来了奇怪的声音。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou'd better not push
this button. Your enemies
must have hidden it carefully
for you to find: it must be
some sort of nefarious trap.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你最好不要按这个按钮。
你的敌人一定把它藏得很隐蔽，让你发现它：这肯定是个阴险的陷阱。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decided not
to pull any handles.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你决定不去拉任何把手。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is where you pressed
the small button that caused
some strange sound to come
from the stairs near the hallway.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这里就是你按下小按钮的地方，按下后走廊附近的楼梯处传来了奇怪的声音。

scripts.text: *Grrr~*
scripts.translation: *怒吼~*

scripts.text:
^3355FFAn extremely vicious
looking dog is glaring
at you. Can you really
pass by this creature
without getting hurt?^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF一只看起来极其凶恶的狗正瞪着你。你真的能毫发无伤地从它身边经过吗？^000000

scripts.text: March forward
scripts.translation: 向前进

scripts.text: Run away
scripts.translation: 逃跑

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait! Perhaps you can
use food to soothe the
savage beast. Why don't
you feed it some of your Pet
Food and see what happens?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等等！
也许你可以用食物来安抚这只凶猛的野兽。
为什么不喂它一些你的宠物饲料，看看会发生什么？^000000

scripts.text: Give Pet Food
scripts.translation: 给宠物饲料

scripts.text: It won't work!
scripts.translation: 没用！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou gingerly throw the
Pet Food towards the dog.
Its tail shakes violently as
it devours the food. You'd
better pass this dog now
while you have the chance!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你小心翼翼地朝狗扔去宠物饲料。
它的尾巴剧烈地摇动，狼吞虎咽地吃掉了食物。
趁现在有机会，你最好赶紧通过这只狗！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou slowly approach
the dog, but it won't
stop snarling at you.
You try to run past the
dog, but it blocks all of
your moves. What to do?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你慢慢靠近那只狗，但它不停地对你咆哮。
你试图从狗身边跑过去，但它挡住了你所有的路。
怎么办？^000000

scripts.text:
[Vicious Dog]
BOW WOW!
BOW WOW!
BOW WOW WOW!
scripts.translation:
[凶恶的狗]
汪！汪！汪汪！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe dog chased you
downstairs like the
suckah chump you are.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF那只狗把你一路追下楼，活像个窝囊废。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFLet's get out of here!^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF我们快离开这里！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's something inside
this drawer, but you can't
take it since you're carrying
to many items with you. Maybe
you should pay a visit to your
trusty Kafra Storage first.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF抽屉里有些东西，但你现在带的物品太多，拿不走。也许该先去卡普拉仓库存些东西。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find an old drawer
^that has been closed.
^If you open it, then you
^might find something
^inside. Or could it be
^empty. Who knows?^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现一个关着的旧抽屉。^如果打开它，^说不定能在里面找到东西。^也可能是空的。谁知道呢？^000000

scripts.text: Open Drawer
scripts.translation: 打开抽屉

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou obtain a Yellow
Keycard from inside the
drawer. Opening that drawer
turned out to be worthwhile.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你从抽屉里找到一张黄色钥匙卡。
看来打开抽屉是值得的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFForget opening that
drawer. I mean, come on,
what would be the point?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF还是别打开那个抽屉了。
我是说，拜托，那有什么意义呢？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is where you
found the Yellow Keycard.
This drawer is now empty.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这就是你找到黄色钥匙卡片的地方。
这个抽屉现在是空的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFA solid box is laid
on the floor in which
a smaller, locked box
has been placed inside.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF地板上放着一个结实的箱子，里面装着一个较小的、上了锁的箱子。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFA solid box is laid
on the floor in which
a smaller, locked box
has been placed inside.
Perhaps you can use your
Old Bronze Key to unlock it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF地板上放着一个结实的大箱子，里面装着一个较小的上锁箱子。也许你可以用旧青铜钥匙打开它。^000000

scripts.text: Use Old Bronze Key
scripts.translation: 旧青铜钥匙

scripts.text: No, it'll never work.
scripts.translation: 不，那肯定行不通

scripts.text:
^3355FFYour hunch paid off!
The Old Bronze Key really
did unlock that box! You
open the inner box and
obtain the Green Keycard
that was locked inside.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你的直觉没错！
旧青铜钥匙真的打开了那个箱子！
你打开里面的小箱子，拿到了锁在其中的绿色钥匙卡。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhat...?
What? Using a key
to unlock a lock?
Come on, that's
freakin' crazy talk!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF什么...？
什么？用钥匙开锁？
拜托，这也太疯狂了吧！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the box from
which you've obtained
the Green Keycard.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这就是那个获得绿色钥匙卡的箱子。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFOne of the books on
this crammed bookshelf
is labeled with the note,
''To Elly.'' It must have been
left behind by her grandfather.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这个塞得满满的书架上，有一本书贴着标签，写着“给艾莉”。
那一定是她的祖父留下的。^000000

scripts.text: Examine Book
scripts.translation: 检查书籍

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou skim through the
book's pages, and don't
find anything particularly
interesting. However, you
notice a steel surface behind the
shelf as you place the book back.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你快速翻阅了书页，没有发现什么特别有趣的内容。
不过，当你把书放回去时，你注意到书架后面有一块钢制表面。^000000

scripts.text: Examine the steel surface
scripts.translation: 检查钢制表面

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou remove more of the
shelf's books to reveal
that the steel surface is
part of a safe hidden behind
the bookshelf. There are two
keyholes on the steel safe.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你移开书架上的一些书，发现那块钢板是隐藏在书架后面的保险柜的一部分。
钢制保险柜上有两个钥匙孔。^000000

scripts.text: Try all your keys
scripts.translation: 尝试所有的钥匙

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

steel, but I used my rage
to destroy it. The second

^3355FF基尔^000000一直在对人形机器人进行异常改造。此事已报告给基尔·海尔，他已经前去阻止基尔，但至今没有回来。

[Kiel Hyre]

robotics for thirty-two
years now. I'm proud to
say that I've succeeded
where the great Sage
Varmundt did not.
scripts.translation:

我研究机器人技术已经三十二年了。我很自豪地说，我做到了伟大的贤者瓦尔蒙特未能做到的事。

It's been my dream to
develop humanoid robots
from humans. Those Guardians
might be robots too, but they
don't operate using free will.

[基尔·海尔]

for the creation of Third

modify his creations for
some sinister purpose.

第三代机器人（如艾莉）的创造主要归功于他。
不幸的是，他正试图出于某种邪恶目的修改他的造物。

scripts.text:

but I ended up getting
locked inside the factory.
I don't know why he wants
to do this. I still have
absolutely no clue...
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以我想，这位艾莉西亚一定是你深爱的女子，而你的机器人就是以她为原型设计的。

[基尔·海尔]
...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think this is what happened:
when you were a young, poor
man, you fell in love with
Allysia. However, she was
in love with Rosimier, who
was rich and powerful.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得事情是这样的：当你还是个贫穷的年轻人时，你爱上了艾莉西亚。
然而，她爱的是富有且有权势的罗西米尔。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However, Rosimier was
betrothed to some other
woman, and he ended up
marrying his fiancee, thus
breaking Allysia's heart.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是，罗西米尔已经与别的女子订婚，并最终娶了他的未婚妻，从而伤了艾莉西亚的心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Feeling betrayed, her
heart broken, Allysia jumped
into a river. Then, you decided
to get revenge on Rosimier, so
you ended up joining
Rekenber Corporation!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
感到被背叛、心碎欲绝的艾莉西亚跳河自尽了。
于是，你决定向罗西米尔复仇，所以最后加入了雷肯贝尔公司！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Hahahahahahaha!
Oh, what an imagination~
That's very ridiculous...
Though, I admit, maybe
I did design Allysia after
seeing that woman long ago.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！想象力真丰富~这也太荒唐了...不过我承认，也许我确实是在很久以前见过那位女子后，才设计出艾莉西亚的。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I'd almost forgotten
about her! I think we
were friends... Though,
where did you get the idea
that I might have
been in love with her?
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
我几乎都忘了她！我想我们曾经是朋友...不过，你怎么会觉得我可能爱过她？

scripts.text: Reveal Kiel's Portrait from Hut
scripts.translation: 展示小屋里的基尔画像

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Wh-what...
How did...
Where did you...?
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
什...什么...你怎么...你从哪里...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Kiel Hyre, I found this
portrait of you as a young
man from the house of the
man that bought Allysia's ring.
I even spoke to the fisherman
that discovered Allysia's body.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
基尔·海尔，我在买下艾莉西亚戒指的那位男子的房子里，发现了这幅你年轻时的画像。
我还和发现艾莉西亚尸体的渔夫谈过话。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You paid an awful lot
of money to buy Allysia's
ring. How can you not tell
me that you didn't love her?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你花了那么多钱买下艾莉西亚的戒指。你怎么还能说自己不爱她呢？

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
*Sigh...*
You got me, you got me.
I didn't want you to learn
the truth. You are correct.
I loved Allysia, and designed
my robot to look just like her.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
*叹气...*
你说中了。我不想让你知道真相。你说得对，我爱艾莉西亚，并以她为原型设计了我的机器人。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I could never forget her.
Ever. But I would never
do anything to harm the
Rosimiers! I'm a scientist!
I hated him when I was young,
but things are different now!
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
我永远不会忘记她。
永远。
但我绝不会做任何伤害罗西米尔家族的事！
我是一名科学家！
我年轻时恨他，但现在情况不同了！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I shed no tears when the
Rosimiers fell, but I wasn't
responsible. Besides, I didn't
have the resources or the
capability to cause it...
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
罗西米尔家族衰落时，我没有为他们流泪，但这并非我所为。况且，我既没有资源，也没有能力造成这一切...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm afraid that the
evidence shows otherwise.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
恐怕证据显示并非如此。

scripts.text: Reveal Portrait of Rosimiers
scripts.translation: 展示罗西米尔家族的画像

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Take a good look
at this portrait that
I found at the Rosimiers'
old house. Do you see
anything... incriminating?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
仔细看看我在罗西米尔老宅找到的这幅画像。你能看出什么...可疑之处吗？

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Aside from that
James Rosimier, you
mean? No! I don't see
anything wrong with
this picture at all.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
除了那个詹姆斯·罗西米尔，你是说？
不！
我看这幅画完全没问题。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Take a good look
at the pocketwatch
in the portrait. That's
the pocketwatch you
wear today, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好好看看画像里的怀表。
那就是你今天戴的怀表，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
...!!!

[{0}]
You might not have caused
the downfall of the Rosimiers
yourself, but with the aid of
the Rekenber Corporation, I'd
say it was entirely possible!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
也许你并没有亲手导致罗西米尔家族的覆灭，但借助雷肯贝尔公司的力量，我认为这完全有可能！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Well played, adventurer.
Well played. I don't regret
what I did: they killed my
Allysia! If James didn't betray
her, if only he didn't drive
her to commit suicide...
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
干得好，冒险者。
我不后悔自己做过的事：是他们夺走了我的艾莉西亚！如果詹姆斯没有背叛她，如果他没有逼得她自杀就好了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's where you're wrong!
Allysia was killed, she didn't
commit suicide. Take a good
look at this note right here!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你错了！
艾莉西亚是被杀的，她并没有自杀。
好好看看这张纸条！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
What?!
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
什么？！

scripts.text: Show James's Note
scripts.translation: 展示詹姆斯的纸条

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
What does this prove?
This doesn't show that
James didn't betray Allysia.
How does this change anything?
She's dead, nothing I can do
will bring her back to me!
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
这能证明什么？这并不能证明詹姆斯没有背叛艾莉西亚。
这改变不了什么。她已经死了，我做什么都无法让她回到我身边！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I never said James didn't
betray her. Look at the date
on the note. James made plans
to run away with her on August
20th. However, her body was
found on the same day.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我从未说过詹姆斯没有背叛她。
看看纸条上的日期。
詹姆斯计划在8月20日和她私奔。
然而，她的尸体是在同一天被发现的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ergo, Allysia must have
died on August 19th. If she
was planning to run away with
her love on the next day, then
she had no reason to kill herself!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
因此，艾莉西亚一定是在8月19日死的。
如果她计划第二天和她爱的人私奔，那么她就没有理由自杀！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
No, that's not right!
She probably couldn't
trust me! She must have
realized she was nothing
but another toy to him!
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
不，不对！
她大概是不信任我！
她一定意识到自己只是他的又一个玩物！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh yeah? I say she jumped
into the river because you
met her on that day. Now,
take a good look at this!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦？
我认为她跳河是因为你那天见了她。
现在，好好看看这个！

scripts.text: Show K.H.'s note
scripts.translation: 展示K.H.的纸条

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This note was  written by
a man with your initials,
K.H. These initials were also
signed on her portrait. You
must have written this note:
there's too many coincidences!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这张纸条是一个署名K.H.的人写的。这个缩写也签在她的画像上。一定是你写的：巧合未免太多了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
According to this note,
you told Allysia that you
wanted to see her again
at the place you first met.
I think you did see her again...
on August 19th, the day she died!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
根据这张纸条，你约艾莉西亚到你们初次相遇的地方见面。我想你们确实见了面...就在8月19日，也就是她去世的那天！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm assuming the place you
two first met was near the
river. No more of your lies:
Tell me what really happened!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我推测你们第一次见面的地方在河边。
别再撒谎了：告诉我到底发生了什么！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Hah... Ha ha ha...
Yes... That's right...
That horrible night.
I remember it well...
.....................
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
哈...哈哈哈...是的...没错...那个可怕的夜晚。我记得很清楚... ...

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
That night, when she came
to the river to meet me as
I had asked, I begged her to
run away with me, instead
of waiting for that James.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
那天晚上，当她来到河边见我，正如我所要求的，我恳求她跟我私奔，而不是等那个詹姆斯。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
She insisted that James
never betrayed her, and he
promised to take her away
with him the next day. Can
you imagine how that made
me feel? I was nothing to her.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
她坚持说詹姆斯从未背叛过她，并承诺第二天会带她走。
你能想象那让我感觉如何吗？
我对她来说什么都不是。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
My feelings didn't matter to
her at all! She kept fidgeting
with that ring...I lost control
and tried to take that damned
thing away from her, and
throw it into the river...
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
我的感情对她来说一点都不重要！她一直摆弄那枚戒指...我失控了，想夺走那该死的戒指，把它扔进河里...

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
But you know what?
She struggled, she actually
fought me! It was just a small
fight, but then, before I knew
it, the ground underneath us
collapsed and... the rains...
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
但你知道吗？她挣扎了，真的和我扭打起来！虽然只是小小的争执，可我还没反应过来，脚下的地面就塌了...还有那场雨...

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I'm not sure what it
was. The rain weakened
the ground, something went
wrong... and she just... just...
The river swallowed her...
I felt empty. She was gone.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
我不确定发生了什么。雨水冲松了地面，出了意外...她就...就...被河水吞没了...我感到一片空虚。她不在了。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
You already know that
she was found dead the
next day. But what really
broke my heart was that
she held that ring so tightly
in her hand, even in death...
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
你肯定已经知道了，第二天人们发现了她的尸体。
但真正让我心碎的是，直到死后，她的手里都紧紧握着那枚戒指...

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
His family had everything
while I had nothing. And
he had the audacity to take
Allysia away from me?!
How could that be right?
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
他的家族拥有一切，而我一无所有。
而他竟然有胆量把艾莉西亚从我身边夺走？！
这怎么可能公平？

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Even though she had passed
away, I still wanted to prove
to Allysia what kind of ugly
person James really was.
That was when I joined the
Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
即使她已经去世了，我仍然想向艾莉西亚证明，詹姆斯究竟是个多么丑陋的人。
就在那时，我加入了雷肯贝尔公司。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I designed the very first
First Generation Robot, which
I named Allysia, and sold the
designs to Rekenber. I gave them
robots, and they gave me money,
power, obedient subordinates.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
我设计了第一代机器人，并给它取名为艾莉西亚，然后将设计图卖给了雷肯贝尔。
我给他们机器人，他们给我金钱、权力，以及顺从的部下。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Of course I knew they'd use
my robots for spying and killing!
But you know what? It didn't
matter so long as they gave me
the means to my revenge. It was
the perfect partnership, really.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
我当然知道他们会用我的机器人进行间谍活动和杀戮！
但你知道吗？
只要他们给我复仇的手段，这就无所谓了。
这真是一段完美的合作关系。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
You've got me right
where you want me.
Who are you working
for, and what exactly
do you want? My designs?
My death? Everything...?
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
你已经把我逼到绝境了。你为谁工作？到底想要什么？我的设计图？我的命？还是一切...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, I just want
to ask about the nature
of your professional
relationship with the
Rekenber Corporation.
And about Kiehl.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，我只是想问问你和雷肯贝尔公司之间的职业关系。
还有关于基尔。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Kiehl, eh? After hearing
my crazy story, I'm guessing
that you already suspect the
truth about him... He's also
a robot, specifically the first
of the Second Generation models.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
基尔，是吗？听完我这段疯狂的故事，我猜你已经猜到他的真相了...他也是机器人，具体来说，是第二代的第一台机型。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
His mind was developed using.
an experimental, and unstable,
form of the Condensed Magic
Spell Scrolls. He was the only
Second Generation robot that
I was allowed to keep.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
他的思维系统基于一种实验性且不稳定的浓缩魔法卷轴开发。他是唯一一台我获准保留的第二代机器人。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I've become very attached
to Kiehl. It's not surprising,
seeing that robotics have
become my life. I even raised
him as my own son, and taught
him everything about robotics
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
我对基尔产生了很深的感情。这也不奇怪，毕竟机器人技术就是我的人生。我甚至把他当亲生儿子抚养，教给他所有机器人技术。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Kiehl is now a genius,
and has even developed the
Third Generation of robots.
Unfortunately, I failed to
properly raise him with
human morals and ethics.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
基尔现在是个天才，甚至开发了第三代机器人。
不幸的是，我没能用人类的道德和伦理正确地教育他。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
He's been transforming
the Third Generation robots
into killing machines. That's
why I tried to put them all
into the academy, so they
could learn human behavior.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
他一直在将第三代机器人改造成杀戮机器。
所以我试图把它们都送进学院，让它们学习人类的行为。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Although the academy
has delayed Kiehl's plans,
he has succeeded into
converting all of the robots
into uncontrollable engines
of mass destruction.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
虽然学院拖慢了基尔的计划，但他还是成功把所有机器人都改造成了无法控制的大规模杀戮机器。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Yes, he's been working
closely with Rekenber.
Their true objective is to
create killing machines
for Rekenber's use.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
是的，他一直在与雷肯贝尔密切合作。
他们的真正目标是为雷肯贝尔制造杀戮机器。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
You know all the secrets
of my past now. I'm not
upset with you or anything,
but I do have something
that I want to ask of you.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
你现在知道了我过去的所有秘密。
我对你并不生气，但我有一件事想请求你。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Please! Stop Kiehl!
I don't want his madness
to destroy any more robots!
I see each and every one
of them as one of my children!
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
求你了！
阻止基尔！
我不希望他的疯狂再毁掉更多的机器人！
我把它们每一个都视为我的孩子！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I know that I must take
full responsibility for all
that has happened. I promise
to take any punishment for
my actions once everything
has been resolved.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
我知道我必须为所发生的一切承担全部责任。
我承诺，一旦事情解决，我会接受对我行为的一切惩罚。

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Okay
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: Nod
scripts.translation: 点头

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Thank you so much!
You can find Kiehl
in the underground
level in this mansion.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
非常感谢你！
你可以在这栋宅邸的地下层找到基尔。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
He stays in the old room
where he was created, but
he reconstructed it as some
kind of cave to keep everyone
out, including me. Yes, he
doesn't trust anyone anymore...
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
他待在他被创造出来的那个旧房间里，但他把那里改造成了某种洞穴，以阻止任何人进入，包括我。
是的，他不再信任任何人了...

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
When you find him, I want
you to take Allysia's ring
out of his heart. If you
remove it, that should stop
him from going berserk.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
当你找到他时，我要你取出他心脏里的艾莉西亚的戒指。
如果你把它取出来，应该就能阻止他进入狂暴状态。

scripts.text: Allysia's Ring?
scripts.translation: 艾莉西亚的戒指？

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Yes... Her ring is the
beginning of everything
I put that in his heart so
that I'd never forget what
the Rosimiers did to me.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
是的...她的戒指是一切的开端。
我把它放在他心脏里，是为了让我永远不要忘记罗西米尔一家对我做的事。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I think Kiehl's grown
so powerful that normal
weapons might not work
on him anymore. Use this
device that will cause his
power supply to fluctuate.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
我觉得基尔已经变得非常强大，普通的武器可能对他不起作用了。
使用这个装置，它会导致他的电源波动。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
If you successfully attach
this to Kiehl's body, then
he won't be able to use his
body's full power. While he's
weakened, open up his chest
and get the ring from his heart.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
如果你成功地将这个装置安装在基尔身上，他就无法发挥身体的全部力量。
趁他虚弱时，打开他的胸腔，从他的心脏里取出戒指。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Let me know once
you're ready. Then, I'll
guide you Kiehl's room.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
准备好后告诉我。我会带你去基尔的房间。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Are you ready
to confront
Kiehl now?
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
你现在准备好面对基尔了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
There... the secret
passage is open now.
Just go to the right of
me, but be careful. Kiehl
is extremely dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
那里...秘密通道现在打开了。
走到我的右边，但小心点。
基尔极其危险。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Please take your
time. I imagine that
it won't be easy.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
请慢慢来。
我想这不会容易。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
You're back...!
So were you able
to retrieve Allysia's
Ring from Kiehl's heart?
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
你回来了...！
那么，你成功从基尔的心脏里取出了艾莉西亚的戒指吗？

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
You mean... You don't have it?
Please, retrieve Allysia's Ring
from Kiehl's heart!
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
你的意思是...你没有拿到？
求你了，从基尔的心脏里取出艾莉西亚的戒指！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Wh-what happened...?
Kiehl developed a new
body for himself? Th-that
would make him a Fourth
Generation robot. I had
no idea he was this smart.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
什...发生什么事了...？基尔给自己造了一个新身体？那...那就意味着他成了第四代机器人。我没想到他这么聪明。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Wait, now that I think about
it, I did see robot bodies that
looked like Kiehl when I was
locked in the factory. So he
was using those copies to
develop personal upgrades.
scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
等等，现在想想，当我被锁在工厂里时，确实看到过看起来像基尔的机器人身体。
所以他一直在利用那些复制品来开发个人升级。

Here, please take this
Keycard which will let you
enter and investigate the
deepest levels of the factory.

scripts.translation:
[基尔·海尔]
给你，请拿着这张门禁卡，它可以让你进入并调查工厂的最深层。
我会去调查基尔的房间。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Who are you?
How did you get here?
Go away
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
你是谁？
你怎么进来的？
滚开

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
You must be surprised
by everything that's been
happening. Maybe everything
would be easier to understand
if I explained about robots?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
最近发生的一切一定让你很惊讶吧。也许我解释一下机器人的事，一切就容易理解了？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
The robots you've been
encountering are automated
mechanical puppets that can
independantly think and operate.
Many sages have tried to develop
their own robots, but have failed.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
你遇到的机器人是自动机械傀儡，能够独立思考和运作。许多贤者都曾尝试开发机器人，但都失败了。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
My master, Kiel Hyre, has
been studying robotics since
he was twenty years old, and
has developed three different
generations of robots, the first,
second, and third generations.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
我的主人基尔·海尔从二十岁起就开始研究机器人技术，并开发了三个世代的机器人：第一代、第二代和第三代。

scripts.text: First Generation
scripts.translation: 第一代

scripts.text: Second Generation
scripts.translation: 第二代

scripts.text: Third Generation
scripts.translation: 第三代

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
I am a good example of one
of Kiel Hyre's First Generation
robots. I was constructed using
a heavy mechanical framework,
a robotic heart, and chemically
synthesized skin covering.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
我就是基尔·海尔第一代机器人的一个典型例子。
我由沉重的机械框架、机械心脏以及化学合成皮肤覆盖层构成。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
My central processing unit,
equivalent to your brain, is
essentially a Memory Scroll
based on the design of the
Magic Spell Scrolls that you
adventurers use in battle.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
我的中央处理单元，相当于你们的大脑，本质上是一种记忆卷轴，其设计基于你们冒险者在战斗中使用的魔法卷轴。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
I'm the oldest type of
humanoid robot, so I weigh
a lot, and my mind can only
process a limited amount of
data. Therefore, I can't express
emotion similarly to a human.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
我是最早的人形机器人，因此体重很重，而且思维只能处理有限的数据。所以我无法像人类那样表达情感。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
The First Generation robots
were developed from mostly
mechanical parts, but the
Second Generation robots
incorporated Homunculus
science and technology.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
第一代机器人主要由机械部件开发而成，但第二代机器人融入了生命体科学和技术。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Second Generation robots
are more life-like since they
have artifically created skin
and flesh, although they still
are constructed from a heavy
mechanical framework.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
第二代机器人有人工制造的皮肤和肌肉，因此更像活物，尽管它们仍由沉重的机械框架构成。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Sage elemental scroll
technology was also used
to develop the Condensed
Memory Scroll, a central
processing unit superior to that
used in First Generation robots.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
贤者的元素卷轴技术也被用于开发浓缩记忆卷轴，这是一种比第一代机器人使用的中央处理单元更优越的部件。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Although Condensed Memory
Scrolls were 100,000 times
more powerful than ordinary
Memory Scrolls, they were
problematic and were prone
to too many error problems.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
虽然浓缩记忆卷轴比普通记忆卷轴强大十万倍，但它们问题很多，容易出现各种错误。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Second Generation robots
were capable of expressing
human-like emotion, but their
production halted after six
years because they were
considered faulty.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
第二代机器人能够表达类似人类的情感，但由于被认为存在故障，在六年之后停止了生产。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Third Generation robots
were mostly designed by
Kiel Hyre's son, Kiehl,
and don't use a mechanical
framework at all: the entire
body is basically a homunculus.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
第三代机器人主要由基尔·海尔的儿子基尔设计，完全不使用机械框架：整个身体基本上就是一个生命体。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
With their organic bodies
and advanced artificial hearts
made from imitation Ymir Heart
Pieces, they can experience
physiologic phenomena
just like ordinary humans.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
它们拥有有机身体和由仿制尤米尔心脏碎片制成的先进人工心脏，因此能像普通人类一样体验生理现象。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Kiehl was able to develop
a more stable form of the
Condensed Memory Scroll
which does not suffer from
critical errors, and can be
cheaply mass processed.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
基尔开发出了更稳定的浓缩记忆卷轴形式，它不会遭受严重错误，并且可以廉价地大规模处理。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Elly is actually a Third
Generation prototype. Once
we optimize the prototypes,
we will begin mass production.
In fact, the academy is our
prototype testing ground.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
艾莉实际上是一个第三代原型机。
一旦我们优化了原型机，我们将开始大规模生产。
事实上，学院就是我们的原型机测试场。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
The fact that out prototype
robots can interact just like
real humans is proof of our
success in robotics.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
我们的原型机器人能够像真正的人类一样互动，这证明了我们的机器人技术取得了成功。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Please let me know if
you'd like to learn more
about Kiel Hyre's robots.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亚]
如果你想了解更多关于基尔·海尔的机器人的信息，请告诉我。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[??????]
All you need to know it
that I'm a secret agent for
the Schwarzwald Republic
government. We're investigating
abnormal activity between Kiel
Hyre and the Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
你只需要知道，我是修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国政府的秘密特工。我们正在调查基尔·海尔与雷肯贝尔公司之间的异常活动。

scripts.text:
[??????]
We saw you enter the
mansion and speak to
Kiel Hyre, so basically
you're here for questioning.
Now tell me the truth. How
do you know Kiel Hyre?
scripts.translation:

我们看到你进入宅邸并和基尔·海尔交谈，所以现在要对你进行询问。告诉我实话：你怎么认识基尔·海尔？

scripts.text: I'll tell you everything!
scripts.translation: 我会告诉你一切！

scripts.text: I don't know nuthin'!
scripts.translation: 我什么都不知道！

scripts.text:
[??????]

You sure about that? Only
a select few can even speak
with Kiel Hyre in person. You
must have some connection
to him. I'm right, aren't it?
scripts.translation:
[??????]
不...什么都不知道？你确定吗？只有少数人能亲自见到基尔·海尔。你一定和他有些关系。我说得对吧？

with here. I'll tell you what

scripts.translation:

你是在试图保护他吗？
我觉得你可能并不真正了解你正在打交道的这个人。
我来告诉你我所了解到的关于他的信息...

scripts.text:
[??????]
Kiel Hyre. CEO of the
Kiel Hyre Foundation,
manufacturer of various
machinery. His company started
as a small Einbroch store whose
technology slowly grew famous.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
基尔·海尔，基尔·海尔基金会的首席执行官，经营着一家机械制造企业。他的公司最初只是艾音布罗克的一家小店，后来凭借技术逐渐声名鹊起。

scripts.text:
[??????]
Rekenber Corperation offered
a merger with the Kiel Hyre
Foundation. We're still not
sure why they wanted Kiel
Hyre in particular to repair
and develop their Guardians...
scripts.translation:
[??????]
雷肯贝尔公司曾提议与基尔·海尔基金会合并。我们仍不清楚他们为何特别希望基尔·海尔来维修和开发他们的守卫...

scripts.text:
[??????]
We're also not sure why
they wanted to suddenly
focus more on Guardian
development. Then, all
of a sudden, Kiel Hyre's son
appears from out of nowehre.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
我们也不清楚他们为何突然更专注于守卫的开发。然后，基尔·海尔的儿子突然冒了出来。

scripts.text:
[??????]
It's very suspicious.
There's no records of his
birth or anything. Still, maybe
Kiel Hyre really did have him
with his secretary, Allysia.
Well, no one is really sure.
scripts.translation:

这很可疑。他的出生没有任何记录。不过，也许基尔·海尔确实和他的秘书艾莉西亚生下了他。没人能确定。

scripts.text:
[??????]
In any case, Kiel Hyre's
son and heir, Kiehl, helped
his father establish this
special academy as their
way of giving back to society.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
无论如何，基尔·海尔的儿子和继承人基尔，帮助他父亲建立了这所特殊的学院，作为他们回馈社会的方式。

scripts.text:
[??????]
Almost every corporation and
organization tried to get their
spies to enter this academy,
but all of them were rejected.
it's strange. At least one of
them should have made it in.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
几乎所有公司和组织都试图派间谍进入这所学院，但全都被拒绝了。真奇怪，至少应该有人能成功潜入。

scripts.text:
[??????]
And recently, Kiehl Hyre
has held a secret meeting with
Rekenber executives to announce
his new project. He intends to
create advanced humanoid robots
that will replace guardians!
scripts.translation:
[??????]
最近，基尔·海尔与雷肯贝尔的高管们举行了一次秘密会议，宣布了他的新项目。他打算创造先进的人形机器人，以取代守卫！

scripts.text:
[??????]
Our spies reported that
Kiel Hyre was nowhere to
be seen at that meeting,
as well as his trusted
secretary, Allysia. He...
He just disappeared!
scripts.translation:
[??????]
我们的间谍报告说，基尔·海尔和他的得力秘书艾莉西亚都没出席那场会议。他...他就这样消失了！

scripts.text:
[??????]
Then, Kiel Hyre pops back
in his mansion after all
this time as if nothing
happened! At the same time,
Kiehl disappears, under the
excuse of conducting research.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
然后，基尔·海尔在这么长时间后突然回到了他的豪宅，仿佛什么都没发生过！
与此同时，基尔以进行研究的借口消失了。

scripts.text:
[??????]
Rekenber is sponsoring
both Kiehl and Kiel, but
there's some kind of conflict
going on between father and
son, I just know it! Now tell
me, what's going on?
scripts.translation:
[??????]
雷肯贝尔同时资助基尔和基尔·海尔，但父子之间肯定发生了某种冲突！现在告诉我，到底出了什么事？

scripts.text:
[??????]
I'm not sure how well you
know this country, but the
fact that Rekenber is invoved
must tell you that these aren't
good people. Tell me what
you know about them!
scripts.translation:
[??????]
我不确定你对这个国家了解多少，但雷肯贝尔卷入其中，足以说明这些人绝非善类。
告诉我你知道的一切！

I've got some new
information for you.

Juno that knew a woman

scripts.translation:

我有一些新情报给你。
朱诺有一位老妇人，她30年前认识一位名叫艾莉西亚的女子。

[Mitchell]
The clincher is that this
Allysia from 30 years ago
commited suicide, and is
identical to Kiel Hyre's
secretary, who is also
named Allysia.
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
关键是，三十年前的艾莉西亚自杀身亡，而她与基尔·海尔的秘书长得一模一样；那位秘书也叫艾莉西亚。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
This is too much of a
coincidence. I want you to
go to Juno and investigate.
When you're done, talk to
Kiel Hyre's steward, and
he'll send you over to me.
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
这太巧合了。
我要你去朱诺调查。
完成后，去找基尔·海尔的管家，他会把你转介给我。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Yeah, I know.
That guy actually
works for me. Anyway,
when you're ready to go
to Juno, let me know, and you
can board the federal airship.
scripts.translation:

是的，我知道。
那个家伙其实是我的人。
总之，当你准备好去朱诺时，告诉我，你就可以登上联邦飞空艇了。

you can get to Juno, and
finish your mission quickly.
scripts.translation:

准备好了吗？
我会让你登上联邦飞空艇，前往朱诺，尽快完成任务。

scripts.text: No

complete your mission,
make sure that you report
to Kiel Hyre's steward so
that he can send you to me.
scripts.translation:

祝你好运。
完成任务后，记得去找基尔·海尔的管家，让他把你转介给我。

But keep in mind that
I'm not a patient woman!
scripts.translation:

慢慢来...但请记住，我可不是一个有耐心的人！

...
啊，我明白了。干得好。不如你去找基尔·海尔，用你了解到的他的过去当面质问他？对，好好盘问他。

so we can send help if
you're endangered. I want
you to find out who Kiel
really is, and what's his
relationship to Rekenber.

scripts.text: What are you doing?
scripts.translation: 你在做什么？

scripts.text: Um, I don't see a baby...
scripts.translation: 嗯，我没看到婴儿

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Oh? My baby won't stop
crying and can't seem
to sleep. She needs to
rest, so I can go to work.
The house is so messy,
and the boss is unhappy...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
哦？我的宝宝一直哭闹，怎么也睡不着。她得休息，这样我才能去上班。家里乱糟糟的，老板也不高兴...

scripts.text: Um, I don't see a baby...
scripts.translation: 嗯，我没看到婴儿

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
What, she's right--
Well. Darling, what
are you doing? Don't
misbehave in front of
our friend! Shhh, be
good, my little girl.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
什么，她就在那儿——好吧。亲爱的，你在做什么？别在朋友面前捣乱！嘘，乖一点，我的小宝贝。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
What are you...?
Oh, look at that.
You made my little
darling cry! Shhh,
hush, little ^0000FFAllysia^000000.
Go to sleeeeeeep~
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你在做什么...？哦，看看你，把我的小宝贝弄哭了！嘘，安静点，小^0000FF艾莉西亚^000000。快快入睡~

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Allysia...?!
Allysia, where did
you go? You were
supposed to come
home a while ago!
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
艾莉西亚...？！
艾莉西亚，你去哪里了？
你应该早就回家了！

scripts.text: Allysia? Isn't she...
scripts.translation: 艾莉西亚？难道她是

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou show Allysia's
portrait to the old woman.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你向老妇人出示了艾莉西亚的画像。^000000

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Oh, do you know
Allysia? She's been
missing! She left home
yesterday and hasn't
come back! C-can you
tell me where she is?!
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
哦，你认识艾莉西亚？她失踪了！昨天离家后就再也没回来！你...你能告诉我她在哪儿吗？！

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Don't worry, Allysia...
Mommy will always be
here for you. There's no
need to be sad...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
别担心，艾莉西亚...妈妈会永远陪在你身边。
不需要难过...

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Oooh, my legs and back
are so sore. These old
bones ache all over...
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
哎哟，我的腿和背都酸痛。这把老骨头浑身都疼...

Inventory space first...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF请稍等...你现在携带的物品太多了，需要先腾出一些背包空间...^000000

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Goodness, I hate this
weather! Reminds me
of how old I've gotten!
It chills my bones, it does!
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
天哪，我讨厌这种天气！
让我想起自己变老了！
真是冷得刺骨啊！

scripts.text: Do you know that grandma?
scripts.translation: 你认识那个老奶奶吗？

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Damn it! If only I didn't
have all those adventures
in my youth! Then maybe
I wouldn't suffer so in
my advanced age!
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
该死！
要是我年轻时没有经历那些冒险就好了！
那样也许我老了就不会这么痛苦了！

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Oh... Yes. She was
the mother of my best
friend, ^3355FFAllysia^000000. Ever since
she commited suicide, things
haven't been the same. Her
mother lost her sanity...
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
哦...是的。她是我最好的朋友^3355FF艾莉西亚^000000的母亲。自从艾莉西亚自杀后，一切都变了。她母亲也失去了理智...

scripts.text: Was ^3355FFAllysia^000000...?

[Old Lady]
Oh, Allysia was such
a beautiful girl. So many
men wanted her, especially
that dashing James Rosimier.
I remember hearing that they
were going to get married...
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
哦，艾莉西亚是个非常美丽的女孩。
很多男人追求她，尤其是那位英俊的詹姆斯·罗西米尔。
我记得听说他们要结婚了...

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
I was so happy for her!
But then, all of a sudden,
she killed herself. Well,
that's what they all say.
Even today, I'm still not
sure what happened.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
我当时真为她高兴！可突然有一天，她自杀了。至少大家都这么说。直到今天，我仍不清楚当时到底发生了什么。

scripts.text: Wait, who's James Rosimier?
scripts.translation: 等等，詹姆斯·罗西米尔是谁？

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Oh, James belonged to
one of the oldest and richest
families in Juno. Everything
was going great for them, but
some time after Allysia died,
the family went bankrupt.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
哦，詹姆斯属于朱诺最古老、最富有的家族之一。
他们一切都很顺利，但在艾莉西亚死后不久，家族就破产了。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
The city manages their
old residence now. For
some reason, they decided
to entrust me with the master
key to the Rosimier Mansion.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
他们的旧宅现在由市政厅管理。不知为何，他们把罗西米尔宅邸的主钥匙交给我保管。

scripts.text: May I borrow the Master Key?
scripts.translation: 借用主钥匙

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Well, I'm really not
supposed to give it to just
anyone, but I can tell that
you're working with Allysia's
best interests at heart.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
虽然按规定我不应该随便把钥匙借给任何人，但我能感觉到，你是真心为了艾莉西亚的利益着想的。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
However, you've got to
make sure that you return
it to me before the people
from City Hall ask me for it.
Alright then, I hope you find
what you're looking for.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
不过，你一定要在市政厅的人来找我之前把钥匙还给我。
好了，希望你能找到你要找的东西。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Please hurry and find
whatever you're searching
for in the Rosimier Mansion.
I might get in trouble if
the people from City Hall
come and ask me for the key...
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
请尽快在罗西米尔宅邸找到你要找的东西。要是市政厅的人来找我索要钥匙，我可能会惹上麻烦...

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Oh, you're finished
searching the mansion?
Depressing, isn't it?
The creditors basically
ransacked everything
a very long time ago.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
哦，你搜完宅邸了吗？
真令人沮丧，不是吗？
很久以前，债主们就已经把这里翻得底朝天了。

scripts.text: Why did ^3355FFAllysia^000000...?

[Old Lady]
Well, I know that James
and Allysia were in love,
and he promised to marry
her. Now, supposedly his
family already betrothed
him to another woman.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
嗯，我知道詹姆斯和艾莉西亚是相爱的，他也承诺要娶她。
但据说他的家族已经为他许下了另一门亲事。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Time went by, and he
was forced to marry his
fiancee. Allysia was pretty
devastated. I think maybe
that's what she... you know...
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
后来他被迫娶了未婚妻。艾莉西亚非常伤心。我想也许她就是因此...你知道的...

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Listen, if you want to learn
more about what happened,
then I think you should talk
to the ^3355FFfisherman that lives^000000
^3355FFsouth of the Kiel Hyre Academy.^000000
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
听着，如果你想了解更多关于这件事的真相，我想你应该去和^3355FF住在^000000^3355FF基尔·海尔学院南边^000000的渔夫谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
He's the one that found
Allysia's body in the river,
so he might have a better
idea of what had happened.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
就是他发现了艾莉西亚的尸体，所以他可能对当时发生的事有更清楚的了解。

scripts.text:

Yep, Rain's coming.
Can feel it in my bones.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
没错，要下雨了。
我的骨头都感觉到了。
