scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
These days, it's much
harder to catch and fish.
Ever since they built
this factory, the fish
have started to change,
and they look different too...
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
最近捕鱼越来越难了。自从那座工厂建成后，鱼开始变异，样子也变得不一样...

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
Eh? You want something?
Heh, youngsters! I know
how much you love handouts,
but you're not getting any.
Now, if you bring me some
Raw Fish, I'd be more friendly~
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
嗯？你想要什么？嘿，年轻人！我知道你们喜欢白拿东西，但我可不会送你。要是你带些生鱼来，我倒会好说话些~

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
Oh, is all this fish
for me? Heh, how very
generous of you. If you're
going to be so kind, then
I suppose I have to repay
the favor. Ask me anything~
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
哦，这些鱼都是给我的？
嘿，你真是大方。
既然你这么客气，那我得回报一下。
尽管问我吧~

scripts.text: 30 years ago, a woman killed herself...
scripts.translation: 30年前，有个女人自杀了

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
Oh? Ohh. Oh yeah.
I remember that. Yeah.
it was August 20th, my
wife's birthday. That day,
instead of catching fish,
I caught a dead woman.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
哦？噢...是啊，我记得。那天是8月20日，我妻子的生日。我没捕到鱼，却捞上来一具女尸。

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
Of course, I reported it
to the Juno Police!  They told
me she killed herself since
she was betrayed by her lover,
who also happened to be her
employer. Really tragic stuff.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
当然，我向朱诺警察报了案！他们说她是被情人背叛后自杀的，而那个人恰好也是她的雇主。真是个悲剧。

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
Anyway, when they were
moving her body out of the
river, her hand dropped
some ring. I picked it up,
hoping to sell it later for
some zeny. I know, I know...
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
后来他们把她的尸体从河里捞上来时，她手里掉出了一枚戒指。我捡起来，想着以后卖掉换些Zeny。我知道，我知道...

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
I was pretty lucky the
police didn't see me take
it. Later that day, some guy
came up to me and offered
me a lot of money for it.
I guess it was my lucky day!
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
我很幸运警察没看到我捡走它。
那天晚些时候，有个家伙找到我，出高价买下了它。
我想那是我的幸运之日！

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
I found out later that he was
some mechanical repairman--
something. He sold everything
to buy that ring, so I guess
he wanted it desperately.
Then he just dissapeared.
scripts.translation:
[渔夫]
后来我才知道，那人好像是个机械修理工。他卖掉所有东西买下那枚戒指，看来当时急需它。之后他就消失了。

scripts.text: Do you remember his name?
scripts.translation: 你记得他的名字吗？

scripts.text:

His name...?
It was something like...
Heil? Hyre? Anyway, it
was a long time ago. Oh,
his old house is still around.
scripts.translation:

他的名字...？好像是...海尔？海雷？总之，那是很久以前的事了。哦，他的老房子还在。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I'm surprised you made
it this far, adventurer~
I bid you welcome to my
humble room. I assume that
you've come for the Condensed
Memory Scroll... my mind.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
没想到你能走到这里，冒险者~欢迎来到我的寒舍。我想你是为了浓缩记忆卷轴...也就是我的大脑而来的吧。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
You can understand
why I can't let you have it,
so if you really want the
Condensed Memory Scroll,
then show me what you've got!
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
你应该明白我为什么不能把它给你。
如果你真的想要浓缩记忆卷轴，那就让我看看你的实力吧！

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Hmpf! You're pretty good.
Father must have spent
a lot of money to hire
you. So has he sent
you to kill me?
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
哼！
你还挺厉害的。
父亲一定花了不少钱雇你。
所以，他是派你来杀我的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Kiel Hyre sent me to ask
you to stop turning all of
the Third Generation robots
into killing machines! How
can do something like that
to other robots like you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
基尔·海尔派我来，是要你停止把所有第三代机器人都改造成杀戮机器！你怎么能这样对待和你一样的机器人？

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Why not? It's said that man
was made in the image of God.
Well, robots were made in the
image of man. You humans kill
each other as much as you
like, as far as I can tell.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
为什么不行？
据说人类是按上帝的形象创造的。
那么，机器人就是按人类的形象创造的。
据我所知，你们人类想怎么互相杀戮都可以。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
It might not be ethical
for me to provide weapons
to humans that need them...
But that's what they are.
Weapons. It's more humane
for robots to fight than humans.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
把武器提供给需要武器的人类，或许并不符合伦理...但它们本来就是武器。让机器人去战斗，总比让人类去战斗更人道。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Robots don't naturally
feel pain or emotions...
Not unless they're specially
programmed. Sorry, but I don't
plans to stop what I'm doing.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
机器人天生不会感到疼痛，也不会产生情绪...除非经过特别编程。抱歉，我不打算停止现在做的事。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I am sorry, but I don't have a plan to stop what I am doing.
Aside from that, my father showed me a great example of
how far a human could go for his own selfinishness by destroying a family.
And therefore I don't think that he could create better robots than mine.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
很抱歉，我不打算停止现在做的事。除此之外，我父亲让我亲眼见识到，为了一己私利，人类能做到何种地步，甚至毁掉一个家庭。因此我不认为他能造出比我更好的机器人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Humankind may not be
perfect, but think about
who you're working with!
Rekenber is the epitome of
human evil! How can you
support them like this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
人类也许并不完美，但想想你是在和谁合作吧！
雷肯贝尔是人性之恶的极致！
你怎么能这样支持他们？

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I've had a long relationship
with Rekenber. I'm fully aware
of their capabilities. Do you
remember the first room you
passed on your way here, the
one with all the toys?
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
我和雷肯贝尔合作多年，很清楚他们的能力。你还记得来这里时经过的第一个房间吗？就是摆满玩具的那个。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I bet you didn't know that there
were 5 Second Generation
robots. Me, and my four other
brothers and sisters. Father
built that room so that all
five of us could live together.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
我敢打赌你不知道那里有五个第二代机器人：我，还有另外四个兄弟姐妹。父亲建造那个房间，是为了让我们五个住在一起。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I was the only one to
survive. I returned to
Father and even got a
name. But yes, I know
how bad Rekenber really is...
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
只有我活了下来。
我回到了父亲身边，甚至得到了一个名字。
但没错，我知道雷肯贝尔有多坏...

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I don't... I don't want
to talk about this any more.
You've made me... Just leave.
I think I will let you live.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
我...我不想再谈这件事了。你让我...快走吧。我想我会放你一马。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Freeze!
Kiehl Hyre, you're
under arrest for creating
and trading illegal weapons!
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
站住！
基尔·海尔，你因制造和非法交易武器而被逮捕！

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Ah, Schwarzwald Republic
agents. Heh. I haven't had
this many guests before.
Well, I guess this means
we'll have to fight after
all, you and I. *Sigh* Pity.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
啊，修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的特工。嘿，我还从没接待过这么多客人。看来我们终究还是得打一场了。*叹气* 真遗憾。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
First, in all fairness,
let me take care of these
nuisances. They're just
mindlessly doing their
jobs--sort of like robots-- but
don't worry, they won't be hurt.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
首先，为了公平起见，让我先处理掉这些麻烦。他们只是在机械地执行任务——有点像机器人——但别担心，他们不会受伤。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Nooooo!
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
不——！

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
And now, you and I can
have a proper duel, human.
I'm interested in seeing just
how strong you really are~
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
现在，你和我可以来一场真正的决斗了，人类。
我很好奇，你究竟有多强~

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
D-damn...!
Well played, adventurer.
Well played. I should have
known that Father would send
the very best after me. Still,
you've failed to truly defeat me.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
该死...！干得漂亮，冒险者。干得漂亮。我本该知道父亲会派最强的人来对付我。不过，你还没有真正击败我。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I still have a few
trump cards left
I think... I'll take you
to hell with me... Well,
if robots can go there~
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
我想我还留着几张王牌...我要带你一起下地狱...不过，机器人也能去那里吗~

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
No...! We're locked
in the room! We're...
We're trapped in here!
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
不...！我们被锁在房间里了！我们...我们被困在这里了！

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Yay~ Let's burn
everything down~
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
耶~ 让我们把这里烧个精光~

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Quick, {0},
use Kiel Hyre's power
device, the one that's
supposed to mess with
Kiehl's power supply!
Hurry, use it right now!
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
快，{0}，使用基尔·海尔的电力装置，那个专门用来干扰基尔电源的设备！
快，现在就用！

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Wh-what? I c-can't
move! This day is just
full of surprises. Oh, well.
I guess it's time for me to
use my other trump card.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
什...什么？
我动不了了！
今天真是充满了惊喜。
好吧。
看来是时候让我使出另一张王牌了。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
What...?
How many trump
cards do you have?
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
什么...？
你到底还有多少张王牌？

scripts.text:
[????]
I'm so disappointed...
I can't believe none
of you thought of this.
scripts.translation:
[????]
真让人失望...我真不敢相信你们谁都没想到这一点。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Who are you...?
Show yourself!
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
你是谁...？
出来吧！

scripts.text:
[????]
Please.
Don't insult me.
You know this voice.
It's been talking to
you this entire time~
scripts.translation:
[????]
拜托。
别侮辱我。
你认识这个声音。
它一直在和你说话~

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Impossible...
How can there
be two of you...?!
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
不可能...怎么会有两个你...？！

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Hahahahaha!
I'm a robot!
I can make extra
bodies, switch brains
with them. It's awfully
convenient, let me tell you.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
哈哈哈哈哈！我是机器人！我可以制造额外的身体，再把自己的大脑转移到那些身体里。相信我，这可方便得很。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Anyway, I don't mean to show
off, but I suppose I better
reveal to you my final trump
card. First of all, I know all
about you, Ms. Mitchell Layla~
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
总之，我不想炫耀，但我想我最好向你展示我的最后一张王牌。
首先，我对你了如指掌，米切尔·莱拉小姐~

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
What? How do you
know my name?
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
什么？
你怎么知道我的名字？

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Well, I have a few
spies of my own...
I'll allow him to explain...
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
嗯，我也有自己的几个间谍...让他来解释吧...

scripts.text:
[Masked Man]
Mitchell...
I'm sorry that
you had to get
involved in all this...
scripts.translation:
[蒙面男子]
米切尔...很抱歉让你卷入了这一切...

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Wolkeus? Wolkeus Kaiser?!
You're the spy?! But you risked
your life to save our president!
No! Oh, God! How can this be
happening?! Everything's just...
This is all crazy! All of it!
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
沃尔凯乌斯？沃尔凯乌斯·凯撒？！你是间谍？！可你曾冒着生命危险救了我们的总统！不！天哪！这怎么会发生？！这一切...太疯狂了！全都疯了！

scripts.text:
[Wolkeus]
This is just the result
of elaborate plans that
were made years ago. I didn't
expect you to be this surprised,
Mitchell. It's the way the game
is played. You know that.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔凯乌斯]
这只是多年前精心策划的结果。
我没想到你会这么惊讶，米切尔。
这就是游戏的规则。
你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Mister President...
I failed you... I'm sorry...
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
总统先生...我辜负了您...对不起...

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Well, Kaiser, she took
it pretty badly, but at least
you're being gentlemanly
about it. Well, I'd like for
all of us to get better
acquainted, but...
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
嗯，凯撒，她受了很大打击，不过至少你还算有绅士风度。我本想让大家彼此熟悉一下，不过...

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
We'd better say our
farewells here. This
place will be gone in
five minutes. Ah, and
Ms. Layla, you're coming
with us. We have questions~
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
我们最好就此告别。这里五分钟后就会被炸毁。啊，莱拉小姐，你得跟我们走。我们还有些问题要问你~

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I'm curious as to what
the president's plans are.
Mister Kaiser, if you'll
escort Ms. Layla, please...
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
我很好奇总统的计划是什么。
凯撒先生，麻烦你护送一下蕾拉小姐...

scripts.text:
[Wolkeus Kaiser]
...............................
Sorry, Mitchell.
I gotta do it.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔凯乌斯·凯撒]
...
抱歉，米切尔。
我不得不这么做。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
No, get away! Let me go!
Let go of me, Wolkeus!
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
不，放开我！
让我走！
放开我，沃尔凯乌斯！

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Great, we're done with
that ugly business. Now,
where was I? Ah, right.
Yes. I'm sorry. We don't
have any more time to play.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
很好，那件丑事结束了。
那么，我刚才说到哪了？
啊，对了。
是的，抱歉。
我们没时间再胡闹了。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Here, adventurer.
I'm aware that my father
sent you here to get this.
Consider it my final gift
to him. I'm surprised he left
this ring inside me, though...
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
给你，冒险者。我知道父亲派你来取这个。就当是我送给他的最后一份礼物吧。不过，我很惊讶他竟把这枚戒指留在我体内...

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I imagine that it must
be precious to him. But
I wonder why he placed
it inside me? Well, anyway,
I have a message I'd like
for you to deliver to him.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
我想这枚戒指对他一定很珍贵。可他为什么把它放在我体内？总之，我有句话想请你转告他。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
First... I guess we
should get rid of this
old thing. It was a good
body, and it's served me
well for 23 years. I'll miss
it. Rest well, old Kiehl.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
首先...我想我们该处理掉这个旧身体了。它是个好身体，陪我度过了23年。我会想念它的。安息吧，老基尔。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Now, this was the body
that my father made.
Please tell him that
this means that we're
no longer related to
each other at all.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
现在，这个身体是我父亲制造的。
请告诉他，这意味着我们从此不再有任何关系。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
The body I'm using right now?
I made it myself with the most
advanced technology. Consider
it... a Fourth Generation robot
body if you will. Father will
understand what I mean.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
我现在使用的身体？这是我用最先进的技术亲自制造的。你可以把它看作...第四代机器人身体。父亲会明白我的意思。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Anyway, please tell him
that, and get his old ring
out of my old robot body,
and then give it to him. For
now, let's get out of here: we
just have 3 minutes to evacuate.
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
总之，请告诉他这些，然后从我旧的机器人身体里取出他的旧戒指，再把它交给他。
现在，我们得离开这里：我们只有3分钟撤离时间。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
You're a worthy opponent,
and a human I respect.
I don't know if we'll meet
again, but who knows?
Anyway, I'll open up the
exit for you. Farewell~
scripts.translation:
[基尔]
你是值得尊敬的对手，也是我敬重的人类。我不知道我们是否还会再见，但谁知道呢？总之，我会为你打开出口。再见~

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou retrieve the
ring from the heart of
Kiehl's old robotic body.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你从基尔旧机器人身体的心脏中取出了戒指。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFKiehl's old
robotic body
stands alone,
lifeless and silent.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF基尔的旧机器人身体独自伫立，毫无生气，一片寂静。^000000
